selection_rule: Screen only the seven within-family pairs, no cross-family search.
Require >=2500 users with >=5 rating>=4 TRAIN positives in EACH member of the pair.
Require both directional timestamp-group transition lifts strictly >1.
Among survivors choose greatest TRAIN activity Spearman; this is descriptive engagement, not proof of preference transfer.
Exact Spearman ties: lower maximum across domains of fraction item support<=5, then higher minimum median item support; then lexicographic category pair.
No survivor: stop; do not lower thresholds or add candidates after seeing results.

train_screen.population: Pair-specific TRAIN-eligible users, not the original three-domain eligible intersection
statistics: all four transition counts, probabilities, destination marginals, lifts
train_screen.support_scope: Report both full domain TRAIN-positive support and support within pair-eligible users; tie-break uses pair-eligible support.
train_screen.timestamps: Unordered equal-timestamp groups; outer-product fractional domain counts only between consecutive groups. Destination marginal from these same transitions.
train_screen.zero_counts: All eligible counts >=5; fail on unexpected zeros; undefined correlations are not zero and do not qualify for correlation tie-break.
train_screen.missing_lift: Pairs with undefined directional lifts fail structural screening.
train_screen.exclusions: No validation/test statistics, model metrics, embeddings or final benchmark mappings.

download_plan.source: Official pre-split 0-core deduplicated rating-only files, not future-filtered 5-core or supplied leave-last-out splits.
download_plan.rule: Media first reduces initial acquisition cost, not a selection preference. Do not select a winner until all seven pairs are screened or explicitly revise scope before any statistics.
download_plan.footprint: Compressed bytes unknown pending approval/metadata. Stream gzip into disk-backed TRAIN aggregates; do not load all files in memory. Existing three archives total bytes recorded below.
download_plan.source_row_note: Official rounded all-time counts: CDs 4.8M, Digital 128.8K, Electronics 43.4M, Cell Phones 20.6M, Health 25.3M, Beauty 23.6M. Not TRAIN counts or byte estimates.
download_plan.compute: No model compute authorized. Screening is linear streaming in input rows plus disk-backed per-user timestamp ordering. Measure scan throughput before estimating hours/RAM/disk.

future_protocol.status: proposal only; contingent on qualifying pair and separate approval
future_protocol.data: Same frozen global calendar cutoffs; rating>=4; pair TRAIN-only eligibility/mappings; warm-item evaluation; preserve primary benchmark separately.
future_protocol.optimization: Canonical memory-safe train-only negatives, matched streams, 4 negatives, batch512, Adam0.001; predeclare exposure budget and ten validation opportunities after TRAIN counts, before fits.
future_protocol.evaluation: P@10/R@10/nDCG@10 with coverage; validation-only best macro checkpoint, earliest tie; tests only after both checkpoints frozen.
future_protocol.compute: Not estimable defensibly before eligible population/item vocabulary. No training approved.
